howItWorks.title: Ku eeg Shiinaha. Si xirfad leh u iibso. Waanu kuu keenaynaa.
howItWorks.subtitle: Isticmaal abka si aad uga iibsato 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods iyo JD — ChinaSuuq wuxuu qabtaa iibinta, hubinta, rarka iyo keenista albaabkaaga Soomaaliya.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Fur abka oo sahmi 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods iyo JD — wakhtiga dhabta ah, oo leh turjumid Ingiriis iyo Soomaali ah oo ku dhex jira.
howItWorks.step2Title: Si xirfad leh u qabso alaab kasta
howItWorks.step2Desc: Taabo badhanka + ee alaab kasta oo aad jeceshahay, ama ku dhaqo link-ga alaabta. ChinaSuuq wuxuu si toos ah u ogaadaa qiimaha, sawirada, iyo noocyada.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Xulo midabka, cabirka, moodalka, iyo inta unug ee aad rabto. Barbardhig rarka diyaaradda (7-14 maalmood) iyo badda (25-40 maalmood) oo arag wadarta lacagta degaankaaga.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Dhamaystir bixitaanka ZAAD, eDahab, Premier Wallet, wareejinta bangiga, ama USDT. Waan xaqiijinnaa dalab kasta oo WhatsApp kahor inta aan iibin.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Kooxdayadu waxay ka iibisaan alaab-qeybiyeyaal Shiineed oo la xaqiijiyay, hubiyaan shay kasta oo ku saabsan bakhaarkayaga Shiinaha, oo wadaagtaa sawirro kahor inta aan rarnin.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Xulo qaadashada bakhaarkayaga Hargeisa ama keenidda oo dhan albaabka. Waanu qabannaa canshuuraha, isku-darka, iyo safarkii ugu dambeeyay ilaa cinwaankaaga.
